text:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for chart: service-connector v0.9.4 -> v0.10.0. Reason: values checksum changed and image tag 'stable-202607' resolves to multiple digests across regions (eu-west/us-east). Auto-promotion locked.

nina: noticed this during preflight. registry shows sha256:4444...8888 in eu-west and sha256:9999...aaaa in us-east for the same tag.

theo: that explains the cross-region test mismatch. QA validated against the eu-west image (sha256:4444...8888).

rachel: if we promote the east digest we'll regress the behaviour QA signed off. not safe.

infra-lead: options: 1) pin to QA digest via overlay and run extended canary region-by-region, 2) cancel and re-run build to standardize tag/digest, 3) manual override to force promote now (not recommended).

nina: prefer option 1. I'll open a tiny overlay PR to set `image.digest: sha256:4444...8888` and add `release.redwood/extended-smoke: \"true\"`.

theo: please also include `helm.redwood/allow-promotion: \"pin-connector-901\"` annotation in the PR instructions so we can trace the intent.

rachel: CI note: chart-lint passes, integration flaky in us-east only. we should fail fast if integration errors.

release-coordinator: once PR merges, I will run `/deploy override pin-connector-901` to resume promotion. keep the canary in eu-west first, then us-east.

nina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/connector/PR-901 0 - overlay `overlays/connector/pin-image.yaml` sets `image.digest: sha256:4444...8888` and documents duplicate tag discovery.

deploy-bot: New commit detected on branch `pin-image-digest-901`. Creating locked promotion candidate `pin-connector-901`. To continue promotion add annotation `helm.redwood/allow-promotion: \"pin-connector-901\"` or run `/deploy override pin-connector-901` in thread by @release-coordinator.

release-coordinator: running `/deploy override pin-connector-901` now.

deploy-bot: Override accepted from @release-coordinator. Promotion resumed. Starting canary in eu-west (5% traffic). Extended smoke enabled (12m).

theo: initiating smoke job `smoke/connector --env=canary --checks=health,queues` against eu-west.

(smoke output eu-west)
```
2026-07-21T10:02:11Z  health OK
2026-07-21T10:05:13Z  queue depth stable
2026-07-21T10:13:20Z  latency P95=130ms
```

rachel: eu-west smoke clean. moving to 30% and starting canary in us-east (with pinned digest still enforced).

deploy-bot: Starting us-east canary (3% traffic) after eu-west initial pass. Extended smoke enabled (12m).

nina: us-east smoke running. note: we still hit an integration flake in one test (DB migration check) but retry passed.

(smoke output us-east)
```
2026-07-21T10:30:01Z  health OK
2026-07-21T10:35:09Z  DB migration check flaky -> retried -> OK
2026-07-21T10:38:15Z  latency P95=140ms
```

infra-lead: retries look okay. no new errors. move to 60% across both regions. tracker #DEVOPS-3345 updated with digests and PR link.

release-coordinator: final reminder to include note in release notes: "Pinned image digest to sha256:4444...8888 due to inconsistent tag across regions; performed staged canary in eu-west then us-east; extended smoke passed."
